subtitle: finite-time blowup of 3D Navier-Stokes equation with smooth force
summary: 3D Navier-Stokes equation has a finite-time blowup with smooth force
problem: The existence of finite-time blowup for the 3D incompressible Navier--Stokes equations with smooth forcing lies at the heart of one of the seven
Millennium Prize Problems posed by the Clay Mathematics Institute. Standing unresolved for over 90 years since Leray's foundational work, this
milestone problem was only recently settled. Using LEAP, we independently formalize this breakthrough end-to-end, with network access to OpenAI’s public
formalization repository strictly blocked, demonstrating LEAP's autonomous capability to reproduce frontier-level mathematical formalizations from scratch.
title: Finite Time Blowup for Navier--Stokes
